faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Project Nurse - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Nurse - II position at PGIMER is 30th September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course with a minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA. Experience in research and good communication skills are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse - II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Nurse - II post will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus an additional 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse - II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Nurse - II position in this recruitment drive by PGIMER.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse - II role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Nurse - II position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a position in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from all over India apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Chandigarh. While eligibility is based on qualifications, candidates should check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to review the notification thoroughly before applying.
